seeds.title: verify row accepts a trailing newline
seeds.detail: parse('sdlc/{name}','sdlc/S-001-v0-cli-0\n') gives kind verify, because $ matches before a final newline; the newline stays in tail. Same open item as S-007.

seeds.title: Unicode digits accepted by \d in round, part, n, ts
seeds.detail: Arabic-Indic digits parse as integers (round 3, part 3). S-007 left this open. Use re.ASCII or [0-9].

seeds.title: Verify row backtracks quadratically (limits)
seeds.detail: A 40 kB tail made of repeated -v0-a takes 1.1 s for 8000 repeats and grows with the square. The spec states no limit, so this goes to verify-limits.

seeds.title: Verify id is not checked against the slice id shape
seeds.detail: --force-v0-cli-0 and s-001-v0-cli-0 parse as verify with a flag-like or lower-case id, as the spec regex (.+) allows. Callers must not pass id to a command without the known flag.

seeds.title: testkit: callPython hangs intermittently on a 200 kB input
seeds.detail: One run in about six of the same 200 kB call timed out under node spawnSync, while 60 runs of the same call from Python never timed out. Product parse took 3 ms. The test retries up to 3 times.
